enable_batch_invariant_mode: enable batch-invariant mode to replace torch linear and matmul with deterministic Triton implementations
init_batch_invariance: initialize batch invariance by setting deterministic environment variables and overriding aten ops
override_envs_for_invariance: override environment variables for NCCL, cuBLAS, and torch compile to ensure deterministic execution
matmul_batch_invariant: perform deterministic batch-invariant matrix multiplication supporting 2D, ND, and batched tensor shapes
rms_norm_batch_invariant: apply deterministic RMS normalization along the last dimension using a custom Triton kernel
